name: Summer
description: Summer turns Claude Code into a complete game-dev studio for Summer Engine, the AI-native game engine. Twenty-four auto-trigger skills cover the full pipeline, from brainstorm, design, scaffold, build, debug, ship. Also brings a 37-tool MCP bridge that lets Claude create scenes, run the game, read diagnostics, and import assets directly in your local engine. Say "make me an FPS" and it does.
longDescription:
Ships **78 skills**, **2 commands**, **2 hooks** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (78): `using-summer` (Use when starting any conversation in a Summer Engine project — establishes how to find and use Summer…), `skill-create` (Use when a contributor wants to add a new skill to the Summer library — bootstraps the canonical…), `skill-improve` (Use when a contributor wants to upgrade a Summer skill that is underperforming or to fix a regression…), `skill-test` (Use when a contributor wants to lint a Summer skill before commit, audit the whole library, or check…), `gameskill` (Use when finishing a game-development session and you want to capture what you just learned into Summer's canonical…), `mcpupdate` (Use when improving or maintaining the Summer Engine CLI, its MCP tools (summer_* / "ops"), or its prompt-engineering…), `brainstorming` (Use when starting creative work — designing a game, picking a mechanic, building features or components, modifying behavior), `investigating-bugs` (Use when encountering any bug, test failure, or unexpected behavior, before proposing fixes), and 70 more
- **Commands** (2): `gameskill`, `summer`
- **Hooks** (2): `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`
- **MCP servers** (1): `summer-engine`

Installs with `claude plugin install summer@claude-community` from `SummerEngine/summer`.
